# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

pair_coeff * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Compute temperature
compute mytemp all temp

# Set timestep

thermo 10000
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density pe ke etotal

# Trajectory output

# Run heating simulation
run 1000000

# Write final configuration
write_data final_structure.data
"}</action_input>
